description: Run one bundled Python helper with the given arguments and return what it printed. Needs python3 on this machine. The script runs with no shell, in a fresh temporary folder, with a time limit; output files it writes land in that folder and their paths are returned. Arguments that are absolute paths or contain ".." are refused, so pass data inline (for example a JSON array) and plain file names. Pass ["--help"] to see a calculator's options.

args.description: Command-line arguments, one string each, e.g. ["fit","out.xlsx","--observed","[100,62,48,41]"].

id.description: The calculator id from list_calculators, e.g. "cohort-curve-model/cohort_model.py".

name: run_calculator

files.description: Full paths of files the script wrote.

folder.description: The temporary folder the script ran in.

ok.description: True when the script exited with status 0.

output.description: What the script printed (stdout, then stderr).

title: Run a bundled calculator
